mapper.select: SELECT no, name, poster, type FROM food2 WHERE type LIKE '%'||#{type}||'%' ORDER BY no ASC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/20.0) FROM food2 WHERE type LIKE '%'||#{type}||'%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reserve (rno, fno, id, name, rdate, rtime, inwon) VALUES (res_rno_seq.nextval, #{fno}, #{id}, #{name}, #{rdate}, #{rtime}, #{inwon})
mapper.select: SELECT rno, fno, id, rdate, rtime, inwon, TO_CHAR(regdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') as dbday, poster, f.name, phone, ok FROM reserve r JOIN food2 f ON r.fno=f.no AND id=#{id} ORDER BY rno DESC
SELECT rno, fno, id, r.name, rdate, rtime, inwon, TO_CHAR(regdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') as dbday, poster, f.name, phone, ok FROM reserve r JOIN food2 f ON r.fno=f.no ORDER BY rno DESC
SELECT rno, no, rdate, rtime, inwon, address, phone, parking, poster, type, score, time,f.name FROM reserve r JOIN food f ON r.fno=f.no AND rno=#{rno}
